title: A bearer-token refusal in the OAuth 2.0 error shape
description: A standard envelope, not one of the suite's own: the error body of RFC 6750 §3 (with RFC 6749 §5.2's fields), `{ "error": "<code>", "error_description": "<words>" }`. Routes that take an OAuth bearer token and answer in this shape declare it, such as AgentPod's fleet list. `error` is one of RFC 6750's codes, listed in `$defs/standardCode`, or an extension code its owner records in contracts/error-codes.json as a flat-error.v1 code. `error_description` and `error_uri` are for people and carry no meaning a program may read. Other fields may sit beside them.

standardCode.description: The codes RFC 6750 §3.1 defines. An HTTP contract in this envelope may name them in x-treaty-error-codes without recording them in contracts/error-codes.json, because no product owns them.
